answer: Because the timing is written down against the garden challenge, the plume audit can replay the nebula history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 110 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. That bill is paid per identity, so 318 aliases cost 239 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
